newsitem.title: USA: ITT fills three executive positions.
newsitem.headline: ITT fills three executive positions.

text.p: ITT Corp on Monday named three executives to fill key posts among its gaming operations.

William Hornbuckle, formerly chief operating officer of Mirage Resorts Inc's Treasure Island hotel/casino here, has been named president and chief operating officer of ITT's new Planet Hollywood Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.

The 3,000-room Planet Hollywood Hotel will be patterned after the popular celebrity-themed restaurants of the same name around the world. Construction is set to begin next month with completion set for sometime in 1999.

Donald Wood, deputy controller of ITT Corp, has been named chief financial officer of ITT unit Caesars World Inc. He assumes a position that has been vacant for several months, a company spokesman said.
Wood joined ITT in 1990. Prior to that he was vice president of finance at the Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc Trump Taj Mahal in Atlantic City.

Finally, Richard Waters, a 21-year veteran of the gambling industry, will assume the new position of senior vice president casino operations at Caesars Palace. His experience includes work at Caesars, at the Desert Inn in Las Vegas and at the Horseshoe Casino and Hotel in Bossier City, La.
